name: Codex Remote
desc: Drive Codex on your own Mac from the ChatGPT mobile app.
desc_zh: 用 ChatGPT 手机 App 遥控跑在 Mac 上的 Codex。
solves: Walking away from the desk means the task stops. Remote keeps the thread alive on the host, so you can answer a question or approve an action from your phone.
solves_zh: 一离开工位任务就停。Remote 让线程在主机上继续，你可以用手机回答问题或批准动作。
best_for: Codex is mid-task on your machine and you have to leave the room.
best_for_zh: Codex 正在你的机器上跑任务，而你必须离开一会儿。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — ChatGPT release notes, https://help.openai.com/en/articles/6825453-chatgpt-r）。 ChatGPT release notes, entry under the "May 14, 2026" heading. Preview 2026-05-14; general availability recorded under June 25, 2026 in the same release notes. macOS host only at launch; Windows host support followed on 2026-05-29. 首次公开日期来源：https://help.openai.com/en/articles/6825453-chatgpt-release-notes
